We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join our company and be part of a team that uses the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.

Within Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), we are advancing digital and data capabilities that strengthen technical operations, accelerate insight generation, and improve business outcomes across the product lifecycle. The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics is a newly created and exciting role, and we are looking for a data-minded engineer to join Small Molecule Science and Technology (SMS&T) to lead and build a data engineering and analytics team across Technical Operations.

The Director of Data Engineering and Analytics, reporting to the Executive Director or End to End Technical Leadership Organization, will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating Small Molecule Science & Technology's (SM S&T) data and analytics priorities into execution, adoption, and business value. For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started!

Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving . Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history.

We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences.

The Vice President, Product Engineering
is accountable for Coates’ Software Products and Development Platform, owning the technical vision and roadmap behind the CMS, Web products, and the support & deployment tools used by internal teams and external clients alike. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role partners with regional engineering and product leadership to keep a unified, scalable platform strategy across all core products in Coates’ development roadmap.

Responsibilities

Platform Strategy & Roadmap: Own the technical vision and roadmap for Coates’ core products, including the CMS, Web products, and deployment tooling.
Cross-Regional Alignment: Partner with regional engineering and product leaders to align platform investment with global and regional needs.
Platform Governance: Set architecture standards and technical governance across all core products on the roadmap.

Executive Partnership: Translate CTO and executive strategy into an actionable product engineering plan.
Talent & Culture: Build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization.
Risk & Quality Oversight: Keep platform reliability, security, and scalability ahead of a growing global client base.

Capabilities

Strategic Technical Leadership: Sets a clear technical vision and inspires teams to deliver against it.
Executive Presence: Communicates technical strategy clearly to senior leadership and the CTO.
Cross-Regional Influence: Builds alignment across global stakeholders without direct authority.
Ownership & Accountability: Owns the health and success of Coates’ core platform end-to-end.
Talent Development: Mentors and retains high-performing engineering leaders.
Adaptability: Navigates ambiguity across a global, multi-brand client base.

Required

12+ years in software or product engineering, including 5+ years in senior technical leadership.

Strong background in cloud-native architecture (AWS preferred) and modern web development.
Success leading distributed, cross-regional engineering organizations.
Experience partnering with C-level stakeholders on technical strategy.
Track record delivering platform-level initiatives at scale.
Strong grasp of Agile/Lean delivery practices across distributed teams.

Preferred

Experience in digital signage, QSR, or retail technology.
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Experience with global, multi-region engineering team structures.

$242,000 - $275,000 a year

We are industry leaders who have won awards and set records. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and we successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history.

We are led by a forward-thinking CEO who has demonstrated a true passion for people and making Coates a place where people genuinely enjoy working. Our growth plans enable a focus on providing rapid career advancement opportunities for our talent.

Together, we are creators, allowing us to make our purpose a reality – to create immersive brand experiences for everyone.

Join a Crew that Cares

Be inspired To Be More

We believe in the values that got us here are the ones that will continue to lead us forward. We are excited by what we’ve accomplished, but know the best is yet to come.

Position Summary

The Executive Director, ERP & Value Chain Platform Engineering is a senior technology executive accountable for the enterprise platforms that enable ELC's end-to-end value chain across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and Research & Development. Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Platform Engineering, this role serves as the executive platform owner responsible for the strategy, governance, lifecycle management, modernization, and business outcomes of ELC's SAP-centric ERP and Value Chain platform portfolio.

Operating within ELC's Enterprise Platform Engineering operating model, this leader serves as the primary technology counterpart to Enterprise Product Design Engineering, Tech, Data & Analytics Leaders, Enterprise Architecture, Operations & Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Enterprise Business Services (EBS), and strategic technology partners. The Executive Director translates approved business capabilities into coordinated platform strategies, modernization roadmaps, engineering realization plans, and technology investments while maintaining accountability for platform outcomes beginning at build through production acceptance.

This role governs engineering realization delivered through Enterprise Business Services (EBS), strategic technology partners, and Enterprise Platform Engineering while ensuring engineering quality, platform optimization, operational readiness, and long-term technology sustainability.

Through leadership of the ERP & Value Chain Platform Engineering organization, this role drives enterprise platform modernization, business capability transformation, and continuous improvement across ELC's global value chain. jobs.title: Director, Digital Analytics Architecture and Engineering
jobs.description:
Collette is looking for a Director, Digital Analytics Architecture and Engineering
to join our growing Engineering Team. This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters in Pawtucket, RI .

About Collette: Let Us Show You the World!

There has never been a better time to be in the travel industry. See the world, connect with others, and experience the immersive benefits of one of the trendiest industries when you join the Collette team! As the longest-running tour operator in North America, our family-owned business leads the industry in innovation and expertise. Collette’s passionate team works hard to fulfill travel dreams and is always looking for talent that will help to shape the company’s future. Being part of the Collette team means having a willingness to grow, a desire to learn and ask questions, and a zest for seeing the world. From giving back to local communities to creating incredible experiences for a world of travelers and being part of a value-oriented team that cares for one another – Collette is all about the people. So, what are you waiting for? Your journey starts here.

Job Summary:

The Director, Digital Analytics Architecture and Engineering owns the strategy, architecture, governance, delivery, support, and optimization of the data layer and tagging architecture across the company’s websites, applications, user portals, and downstream marketing systems. This leader defines the blueprint for how customer and behavioral data flows from digital experiences through standardized data layers into tag management systems (TMS) and other downstream platforms. They establish the long-term technical direction and operating model for the digital analytics ecosystem, ensuring that the architecture is scalable, compliant, and capable of producing reliable, actionable data for lead intake, sales generation, and customer experience decisions. This is a new role for Collette, and this person will be responsible for standing up a new architecture for our Digital Products Systems.

This leader aligns product engineering, marketing, analytics, and operations around a shared digital analytics strategy, portfolio priorities, delivery commitments, and measurable outcomes. They establish decision-making and escalation mechanisms, communicate progress and risk to senior stakeholders, and sequence complex initiatives across multiple phases when necessary.

The Director serves as the senior technical authority for the company’s digital analytics ecosystem, including its websites, applications and user portals, data layer architecture, user-driven events, tagging standards, tag management systems (TMS), consent controls, and downstream integrations. They define architectural principles, data contracts, naming conventions, and engineering standards; guide significant technical decisions; and ensure that data moves through the ecosystem securely, consistently, reliably, and sustainably.

Primary Functions:

Define and maintain the end-to-end digital analytics architecture, documenting how customer and behavioral data flows from websites, applications, and user portals through standardized data layers into tag management systems (TMS), analytics platforms, and downstream marketing integrations.
Work with product management to create a product & technical roadmap.
Document change-management decisions and proposed roadmap changes.
Translate business and compliance needs from marketing team into clear technical requirements.
Turn complex technical requirements into quarterly projects and sequence tasks realistically to meet deadlines.
Facilitate alignment among web engineers, marketing analysts, product management and digital analytics, ensuring stakeholders are informed throughout project planning and execution.
Create comprehensive testing plans which include stakeholders’ acceptance testing phases.
Own tracking, consent and data usage requirements; ensure these are included into each project across digital platforms.
As projects bring systems online, coordinate with operations and support teams to identify run-state requirements, support models, handoff needs. Identify production risks so projects are scoped with ongoing ownership in mind.
Lead and develop a management structure that may include managers responsible for distinct areas of digital analytics engineering. Set clear accountabilities, coach leaders, assess organizational capacity, support succession planning, and evolve team structure and skills as the digital analytics portfolio grows.

Knowledge & Skills:

Demonstrated expertise in modern digital-platform architecture across websites, applications, user portals, frontend and backend services, standardized data layers, tag management systems (TMS), and third-party marketing integrations, with the ability to document current-state data flows, define scalable target-state architecture, and set technical direction.
Experience partnering with product management and senior stakeholders to create product and technical roadmaps, govern change decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and translate strategy into realistic quarterly delivery plans.
A track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, marketing, product management, digital analytics, privacy, and operations, establishing clear requirements, decision rights, milestones, and accountability for outcomes.
Deep experience with digital analytics, event tracking, data layer design, tag management systems (TMS), consent management, customer relationship management, and marketing technology platforms, including the governance of event schemas, naming conventions, data collection, usage, quality, and compliance requirements.
Proven ability to produce clear technical, decision, and change-management documentation; define comprehensive testing and stakeholder acceptance plans; and communicate architecture, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience leading engineering or analytics organizations through managers, including setting direction, developing leaders, planning capacity, identifying delivery and production risks early, and establishing sustainable operating and support models.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in taking care of our team—inside and outside of work. The pay range for this position is $180,000 - $215,000.

What We Offer:

Health & Wellness: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage—plus a Peloton One Membership to keep you moving
Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and your birthday!
Volunteer Time: Paid hours to give back to causes you care about
Financial Security: 401(k) with company match
Family Support: Paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave and access to our Employee Assistance Program
Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement to help you level up your skills
Exclusive travel discounts, incentives and more!

Our enterprise container platform manages mission-critical services for major global organizations and enterprise customers around the world.

Security Leadership & Secure SDLC: Embed security best practices across all stages of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including the secure integration and governance of AI technologies and agentic workflows. Hiring, Talent Development & Team Empowerment: Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering organization. Build clear career progression paths, foster an inclusive culture, and empower engineers to take ownership of quality, platform health, and technical innovations.
Balancing Features and Platform Stability: Partner closely with Product Management and executive leadership to align feature delivery with technical debt reduction, system stability, and security enhancements, making disciplined trade-off decisions grounded in operational metrics and customer needs.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Focus: Communicate effectively with executive stakeholders, enterprise customers, and cross-functional teams. Translate real-world customer usage patterns and operational feedback into actionable engineering priorities and platform guardrails.

Experience: Minimum of 7–10 years in software engineering with demonstrated experience leading or managing engineering teams in commercial software ecosystems.

Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;

jobs.title: Senior Manager IT Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are constantly looking to add to our core talent. If you are seeking a career that is challenging and rewarding, a work environment that is diverse and dynamic, look no further — Haemonetics is your employer of choice.

Job Details

The Senior Manager, Information Technology Infrastructure leads the strategy, delivery, security, reliability, and continuous improvement of the organization’s enterprise infrastructure services. This role manages infrastructure operations across cloud and on-premises environments, including compute, storage, customer-facing hosting platforms, data centers, backup and recovery, and end-user technology services. The Senior Manager partners with business and technology leaders to translate organizational needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions while developing a high-performing technical team and ensuring operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure strategy: Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure roadmap aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity requirements, and financial objectives.
Service ownership: Ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and supportability of cloud, network, server, storage, identity, collaboration, backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint services.
Operational excellence: Establish service-level objectives, operational metrics, monitoring, incident response, problem management, change management, capacity planning, patching, lifecycle management, and continuous-improvement practices.
Cybersecurity and compliance: Partner with information security, risk, privacy, and compliance teams to implement required controls, remediate vulnerabilities, support audits, and maintain secure configurations.
Cloud and modernization: Lead cloud adoption, automation, standardization, technical-debt reduction, and modernization initiatives while optimizing performance, resilience, and cost.
Business continuity: Maintain tested backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities; define recovery objectives and coordinate exercises and remediation activities.
People leadership: Hire, coach, develop, and retain infrastructure professionals; establish clear objectives, accountability, succession plans, and development opportunities.
Financial and vendor management: Own budgets, forecasts, licensing, asset lifecycle plans, contracts, sourcing activities, and supplier performance; identify opportunities to improve value and reduce total cost of ownership.
Stakeholder partnership: Communicate service health, risks, priorities, and investment needs to technical and nontechnical leaders; collaborate across applications, security, data, facilities, and business functions.
Governance and documentation: Maintain standards, procedures, architecture documentation, support models, inventories, and decision records that enable reliable and repeatable service delivery.
Escalation leadership: Provide executive-level coordination during critical incidents, ensure timely communications, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, AWS, Veeam, Linux, PDQ or VMware.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure.
Experience supporting regulated & controlled environments (life sciences, healthcare).
10 + years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments., operations, engineering, or service delivery,
5+ years in a people-management role. Talent development and team leadership
Strong knowledge of networking, compute, storage, virtualization, identity and access management, enterprise collaboration, backup and recovery, monitoring, endpoint management, and infrastructure automation.
Experience leading IT service management and infrastructure operations and complex infrastructure transformations.
Proven ability to manage budgets, forecasts, contracts & external providers.
Strategic thinking and disciplined execution
Customer and business orientation
Sound judgment, ownership, and accountability
Clear communication and stakeholder influence
Risk awareness and continuous improvement
Collaboration across technical and business teams

Additional Requirements

May require participation in an on-call escalation rotation and availability outside normal business hours for critical incidents or planned maintenance.
Periodic travel may be required to company sites, data centers, or supplier locations.
Works in a hybrid office and remote environment, subject to organizational policy and business needs.

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this role is:

$124,300.00-$211,700.00/Annual

The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account, without limitation, the candidate’s location, education, job-knowledge, skills, and experience in prior relevant roles.

Incentives may also be provided as part of Haemonetics’ employee compensation. For sales roles
, employees will be eligible for sales incentive (i.e., commission) under the applicable plan terms. For non-sales roles
, employees will be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, the target amount of which varies based on the applicable role, to be governed by the applicable plan terms. Employees may also be eligible to participate in the Company’s long-term incentive plan, with eligibility and target amount dependent on the role.

In addition to compensation, the Company offers a competitive suite of benefits to its employees, including without limitation, a 401(k) with up to a 6% employer match and no vesting period, an employee stock purchase plan, “flexible time off” for salaried employees and, for hourly employees, accrual of three to five weeks’ vacation annually (based on tenure), accrual of up to 64 hours (annually) of paid sick time, paid and/or floating holidays, parental leave, short- and long-term disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and/or health and welfare benefits.

Depending on your location, you may be eligible for more detailed information related to the compensation and benefits related to this job posting. If you believe you may be entitled to such information by law, you may contact 1-781-348-7777, Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. – 5 p.m. ET or email AskHR@Haemonetics.com.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Blackstone Law is growing fast. With nearly 50 attorneys, we’ve become one of California’s leading plaintiff side employment law firms, representing employees in individual and class action employment matters.

We’ve built a fast-moving, technology driven firm that combines experienced legal judgment with technology and automation to work smarter and deliver better outcomes for our clients. We’re looking for talented CTO Professional who are excited about the opportunity to help us grow our presence in a new market.

Our culture is collaborative, comfortable, and performance driven. We work hard, support one another, and believe you can do exceptional work while still having a life outside of it. We’re a family that values each person’s contribution and invests in their growth.

About the Role

Blackstone Law is looking for a forward-thinking, hands-on Chief Technology Officer to lead the next phase of our technology strategy.

We have already made significant investments in technology, AI, automation, and data. We’re looking for an experienced technology leader who will take us to the next level.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role. We need someone who understands how AI, data, software, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and automation work together—and can translate those capabilities into measurable improvements in how a modern law firm operates.

The CTO will partner directly with executive leadership while providing technical direction and accountability to our internal and external technology resources.

While we are primarily seeking a full-time CTO, we are open to considering the right candidate on a fractional basis initially.

What You’ll Do

Own and execute the firm’s technology, AI, data, and infrastructure strategy.

Assess our current technology environment, architecture, systems, integrations, vendors, and development initiatives and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities.

Lead the firm’s AI strategy, including the evaluation, development, implementation, and governance of AI-powered tools and workflows.

Provide technical leadership and accountability for developers, IT resources, consultants, and technology vendors.

Establish clear expectations around project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and performance.

Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve productivity, strengthen knowledge management, and better leverage firm data.

Ensure our technology environment is secure, scalable, reliable, and positioned to support continued growth.

Oversee cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risk.

Evaluate emerging technologies based on practical business value—not technology for technology’s sake.

Partner with the Leadership, attorneys, and operational leaders to translate business needs into practical technology solutions.

Own technology budgeting and help leadership make informed investment decisions.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including CTO, CIO, VP/Head of Technology, or comparable leadership experience.
Proven experience building and executing technology strategies within a growing organization.
Strong technical knowledge across AI, data architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems integration, and software development.
Hands-on experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI and automation solutions.
Experience leading developers, engineers, IT professionals, vendors, and outsourced technology resources.
Ability to quickly assess an existing technology environment and determine what should be scaled, improved, replaced, or rebuilt.
Strong execution and project-management discipline with a track record of turning strategy into measurable results.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical executives and business leaders.
Experience working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial organization.
Law firm or legal technology experience preferred; professional services experience is also highly valued.

Through digital, direct, sampling, fulfillment, and customer care, we manage a full consumer experience that shortens the distance between behavior and action.

The Ask

The Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations is responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-effective operation of corporate technology services while leading the modernization and simplification of Harte Hanks’ infrastructure environment. This role oversees infrastructure and cloud operations, networking, systems engineering, workplace technology, service delivery, and key service providers. The Senior Manager translates the enterprise technology roadmap into measurable execution, with particular emphasis on data center exit, cloud and SaaS adoption, infrastructure consolidation, operational resilience, automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

You are a practical, hands-on technology leader who can operate today’s hybrid environment while deliberately reducing legacy complexity. You combine strong operational discipline with sound technical judgment, financial accountability, vendor management, and the ability to lead distributed teams through change. You know when to standardize, automate, outsource, consolidate, or retire technology, and you can balance modernization objectives with service continuity, security, compliance, and business needs. You communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and senior leaders, and you build a culture of ownership, transparency, customer service, and continuous learning.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and develop a distributed team responsible for infrastructure, cloud, systems, networking, workplace technology, service delivery, and operational support.

Ensure services, projects, and modernization initiatives are delivered within agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk parameters.
Define and document standards, operational procedures, reference patterns, support models, inventories, and service ownership across the technology environment.
Establish and report meaningful SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, operational risks, and modernization progress measures.
Use Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and related Atlassian capabilities to manage operational work, projects, documentation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
Promote practical use of automation, infrastructure as code, artificial intelligence, and modern operations practices to reduce manual work and improve service quality.

Occasionally interact with Harte Hanks clients regarding technology operations, controls, or modernization initiatives.

8+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, systems, or technology operations.
3+ years managing technology professionals, preferably across distributed or globally remote teams supporting business-critical services.
Experience planning and executing data center exits, cloud migrations, infrastructure consolidation, platform modernization, or large-scale technology rationalization.

Experience managing technology budgets, cloud and SaaS consumption, vendors, managed services, contracts, renewals, and cost optimization.

Experience supporting regulated or audited environments and responding to internal, external, or client audit requests.
Working knowledge of infrastructure as code, automation, and scripting using tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, Ansible, or comparable technologies.
Ability to develop roadmaps, business cases, standards, procedures, operating models, and meaningful operational reporting.
Strong leadership, coaching, delegation, prioritization, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical, operational, financial, and risk considerations to senior leaders and business stakeholders.
Calm, credible, and decisive during incidents, competing priorities, and periods of organizational change.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Development
jobs.description:
Overview

SitelogIQ
is a world-class team making a large-scale impact on the efficiency and sustainability of the places we live, work, shop, and heal.

SitelogIQ delivers turnkey solutions across energy efficiency: lighting upgrades
, EV infrastructure
, solar and energy storage system
[distributed generation (DG)] , and other facility improvement measures (FIMs)
that transform built environments and breathe life into the sustainability, financial, and resiliency goals of real estate teams, corporations and public sector organizations across the U.S. Our mission is to make buildings better while making it easy for our clients to accelerate their impact.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering & Development for Distributed Generation
within our Commercial Markets Division
provides strategic leadership and oversight of the project engineering and development function and team. This role establishes departmental priorities and standards across team management, tools and systems, project scope development, engineering execution, budget estimating, scheduling, quality, risk management, and workflow.

Key Components Of This Role Include

Management: Strategic leadership and management of the DG team, including Project Development Engineers; oversight of resource planning, project priorities, workflows, day-to-day operations, training and mentoring, performance, and continuous improvement.
Project Engineering & Development: Direct, facilitate, and/or review site survey [audit] analysis, conceptual project designs, estimating, schedules, product specifications, code research and application, and the preparation of proposal documents.

An effective SitelogIQ Director of Engineering & Development will partner with leaders across Sales, Operations, and Project Management and represent the team and its technical solutions to clients and their technical staff. They will oversee program and project development milestones to deliver timely, comprehensive proposals that clearly communicate project intentions and solutions while meeting SitelogIQ financial and risk metrics. SitelogIQ team members are expected to share knowledge with others by serving as a constant contributor, trainer, mentor, and resource.

Target Salary:
$145,000 - $180,000 dependent on experience.

Director, Engineering & Development Responsibilities

Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to the team as they develop and produce DG project designs and proposals.
Oversee the internal proposal queue, resource allocation, team assignments, risk review process, and client commitments.
Facilitate collaboration between the Engineering & Development and Sales teams to determine customers’ specific technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product feature needs.
Establish and maintain quality standards for project designs, submittals, and permitting packages.
Lead the development of new processes, tools, and workflows and the continuous improvement of existing practices.
Partner with Sales to define customers’ technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product or system feature needs.
Participate in site-surveys, pre-bid and pre-construction meetings as needed; noting that SitelogIQ’s commercial markets team does have an Assessment team devoted to supporting all types of site-surveys including DG projects.
Maintain all internal documentation in a collaborative file sharing and storage environment.
Lead technical strategy and support for large RFP and business development opportunities.
Participate in quality control review of peer project development team
Ensure effective coordination of installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives and support field installation when needed.
Oversee the evaluation of site audits and selection of product solutions that provide clients with the optimal balance of functionality, long-term operating expense, aesthetics, and constructability.
Establish quality control standards and review submittal packages (product data sheets; bill of materials; standard and customer drawings; layout and connection detail drawings; return on investment analysis; etc.) for content accuracy and alignment with proposal goals.
Review and markup drawings for typical product applications
Review and present DG solution proposals
Ensure local jurisdiction code compliance research is completed and incorporated into project solutions.
Partner with construction leaders to establish accurate project cost estimates.
Establish design intent and specifications and ensure the team consistently meets them.
Provide technical leadership for large RFP and business development opportunities, including the creation of detailed submittal packages.
Coordinate installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives. Support field installation when needed
Lead quality control reviews of projects
Any, and all ad hoc reporting, requests or other tasks deemed

Director, Engineering & Development Requirements & Qualifications

Industry experience and credentials required:
At least 10 years of progressive experience in engineering, project development, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading, managing, and developing a team.

Active Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with the ability to obtain additional licenses through comity as required.
Experience understanding audit and field survey data and translating that into design documents and drawings.
Experience performing sales liaison and client collaboration in energy or related industries.
Strong understanding of DG systems and corresponding customer requirements.
Excellent understanding of financial business principles.
Adept at project scheduling, task definition and effort estimation.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects from concept through completion.
Strong design evaluation, documentation writing skills, problem solving skills, and attention to detail.
Professional communication and presentation skills.
Must be able to work independently, with minimal supervision under time sensitive deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.
Experience with file sharing, document management and collaboration tools.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This position operates in both office and field settings. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, talk, hear, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, phone, and keyboard. May regularly need to lift up to 20 lbs., unassisted. Travel will be required for site assessments and customer presentations.

Benefits

We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Disability and life insurance
401K
Flex time off
12 paid holidays
Tuition reimbursement
Opportunities to drive our DE&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization, or Women Inspiring & Strengthening Everyone
Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers

More About SitelogIQ

At SitelogIQ, we’re focused on creating a great environment for our team first so that it is more energizing and rewarding to focus on creating great customer experience. That’s what we call a win-win.

We partner with clients in K-12, higher ed, government, healthcare, multifamily housing, and industry to optimize energy efficiency, improve indoor air quality, address lighting, and improve the customer experience. With offices across the country, it’s rewarding to make a difference in the communities where our teammates live and work.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may be asked to perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the Organization .

SitelogIQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in the E-Verify program.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology, Innovation & AI
jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Corporate Partnerships

OVERALL POSITION DESCRIPTION

World Food Program USA mobilizes American policymakers, businesses and individuals to support the World Food Programme (WFP) in its mission to end hunger. The Vice President, Technology, Innovation and AI will help transform how the organization works, turning technology and innovation into greater capacity, stronger decisions and measurable mission impact.
Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer and Chief Financial Officer, the Vice President leads the IT, CRM and Data Analytics teams and advances the strategic plan by equipping staff with the tools, skills and trusted data to work more effectively. This leader sets and implements an enterprise technology vision, scales integrated data capabilities and embeds useful, responsible AI into everyday work. Success will be demonstrated through sustained staff adoption, measurable return on investment and reliable data integration that improves decisions and donor engagement.
The Vice President combines strategic leadership, business judgment and technical depth. They stay close enough to the work to evaluate architecture, challenge assumptions and guide consequential decisions, stepping in directly when needed. They deliver primarily through team leaders, staff and vendors, translating business needs into effective solutions and presenting progress, opportunities and risks to executive leadership and the Board as appropriate.

Why Join Us?

We are a dynamic, forward leaning, financially stable organization.
You will be joining an effective, committed, high-performing group of colleagues who are well-regarded in the community.
Your opinion will count, having exposure to key stakeholders in the company
You will have access to a host of inclusive benefits including parental leave, an EAP, and a wellness benefit.
You will play a crucial role in aiding the organization in their mission of ending global hunger.

About World Food Program USA

World Food Program USA’s values provide the framework for how we behave and work together to reach our goals to feed and save the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. Those values are:
Collaborative
: We are all one team
Accountable
: We own our work
Respectful
: We are kind to each other
Inclusive
: We champion diversity
Optimistic
: We have a make it happen attitude

We are looking for applicants who embody these values and are invested in forwarding our mission.

Highlighted Responsibilities:

Turn strategy into measurable value

Develop and execute an enterprise technology, data and AI roadmap aligned with the strategic plan. Partner with department leaders to prioritize investments, sequence delivery and establish shared accountability for outcomes.
Build business cases with clear baselines, full implementation and operating costs, expected benefits and adoption measures. Track realized ROI with Finance and business owners, distinguishing financial savings from capacity gains and service improvements.
Set enterprise technology investment priorities and oversee the technology budget and vendor portfolio within delegated authority. Empower team leaders to manage delivery and assigned budgets. Partner with departments that hold technology budgets and ensure all technology selection, purchasing and implementation follows organizational processes, standards and protocols.

Make AI work for people

Lead substantial AI initiatives from opportunity assessment through deployment and sustained use across functions. Select practical use cases, test value and reliability, and scale solutions that demonstrate measurable benefits.
Partner with department leaders and People and Culture to build AI literacy and staff confidence through training, coaching, peer champions and hands-on demonstrations. Address barriers and use staff feedback to improve adoption.
Embed change management in every major initiative, including stakeholder engagement, workflow redesign, communications, training and post-launch support. Measure effective use and business outcomes beyond licenses issued or training completed.
Create a culture of thoughtful experimentation and continuous learning. Apply sound build-versus-buy judgment and guide teams and vendors toward maintainable solutions that fit organizational capacity.

Connect data to decisions

Lead the continued development and integration of enterprise platforms through the CRM and Data Analytics leaders, who own their respective platform roadmaps and delivery. Align their work to provide a secure, trusted view of donors and organizational performance.
Enable the Data Analytics team to scale reliable warehouse capabilities, data pipelines and integrations. Establish shared expectations for data quality, documentation and governance, with business stakeholders accountable for definitions and validation.
Partner with Development, Marketing and Communications, Public Policy, Finance and other teams to translate operational needs into useful analytics, dashboards, automation and AI-enabled workflows.
Set enterprise architecture principles and guide major platform and integration decisions. Establish one accountable technical owner for each integration across delivery, monitoring and ongoing support; resolve ownership and priority conflicts among IT, CRM and Data Analytics.

Build trust in technology

Lead and empower functional leaders to deliver reliable technology services and platforms. Set service expectations, cybersecurity and continuity priorities, and escalation thresholds; review performance across IT, CRM and Data Analytics and remove barriers to delivery.
Lead enterprise technology risk management, with IT responsible for shared infrastructure, identity and access, cybersecurity controls and incident readiness, and CRM and Data Analytics responsible for controls within their platforms. Escalate material risks and investment needs to the COO/CFO and relevant organizational leaders.
Establish and maintain best practices for technology, data and AI governance, including policy development, clear standards and decision authority, and monitoring of adherence and effectiveness. Partner with department leaders and relevant advisers to keep governance practical and responsive to evolving needs.

Grow talent and lead together

Attract, hire, develop and retain strong technical talent. Lead the leaders of IT, CRM and Data Analytics, organizing work around shared priorities and complementary strengths. Coach managers, support succession and hold teams accountable for delivery and service quality.
Build on the strengths of current teams, support professional growth and recommend how capabilities, capacity and ways of working can best advance the strategy.
Build trust across departments by listening to business needs, explaining tradeoffs clearly and resolving competing priorities with the COO/CFO and other leaders. Establish proactive staff communication about technology changes and disruptions, including why changes are happening, expected impact, timing, preparation and support. Ensure timely status updates and expected resolution or next-update times during disruptions.

A well-qualified candidate will possess the following:

Education

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience required.
Master’s degree in information systems, technology management, computer science, business administration or a related field preferred.

Years of experience

At least 15 years of progressively responsible relevant professional experience, including at least eight years of people management experience.

Specific qualifications

Enterprise technology leadership spanning strategy, budgets, vendors, operations and the development of technical teams and managers.
Proven leadership of at least one substantial AI implementation that moved into regular business use, achieved widespread and sustained adoption, and produced measurable organizational results. Experience must extend beyond pilots and individual tool use.
Proven change-management leadership across departments, including stakeholder engagement, staff enablement, workflow change and measurement of sustained adoption.
Experience leading enterprise data warehouse implementation or modernization, integration and governance to provide reliable, accessible business information.
Deep technical judgment applied close to the work: evaluate architecture and integration choices, challenge vendor proposals and recognize when implementation needs intervention. Guide teams effectively and contribute directly when needed.
Sound business judgment: weigh mission impact, cost, risk, staff capacity and competing priorities; make timely decisions and assess whether investments deliver their intended value.
Ability to influence across departments, explain complex subjects clearly and build relationships with colleagues, executives and Board members.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop and organize technical talent, including leading managers and building collaboration across disciplines. Lead with curiosity, accountability, inclusion and respect.
Experience leading the implementation and ongoing oversight of Microsoft Purview, including data classification, retention, data loss prevention, eDiscovery and related compliance controls.
Highly professional collaborator with personal integrity and discretion in handling confidential information; adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity; strong leadership presence and ability to influence others without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications

Substantial Salesforce experience, particularly CRM strategy, integration and adoption. Experience with Snowflake or a comparable enterprise data platform is also valuable.
Experience in a nonprofit or mission-driven organization, with familiarity with fundraising, donor engagement or advocacy operations.
Relevant professional certification in change management, enterprise technology, data architecture or information security. Credentials complement demonstrated delivery and adoption experience.

Location and work arrangement

This position is based in the Washington, DC office and requires a minimum of three days per week in the office. Candidates must reside in the Washington, DC, Maryland or Virginia metropolitan area by their start date. Candidates willing to relocate are welcome; relocation assistance is not available.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit a resume and cover letter to the link provided. No phone calls or agencies, please.

World Food Program USA is a nonprofit organization. This is a full-time position that offers a competitive salary and outstanding benefits. WFP USA is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior VP, Technology
jobs.description:
$200,000 - $350,000 USD yearly

Description

About the Role

Virtium is seeking a Senior VP, Technology to help define the next chapter of our technology strategy as we expand from our strong foundation in industrial memory and storage into broader embedded computing, Edge AI, connectivity, and integrated system-level solutions.

This is a highly visible executive role for a senior technology leader who can combine deep technical credibility, customer insight, product vision, and practical business judgment. The Senior VP, Technology will partner directly with the CTO, executive leadership, customers, technology partners, and internal teams to shape where Virtium invests, differentiates, and grows.

About Virtium

Virtium is a Rancho Santa Margarita, California–based designer and manufacturer of high-reliability industrial embedded solutions for customers whose systems must operate consistently in demanding, long-life environments. For more than 25 years, Virtium has supported global OEMs with industrial-grade SSDs, DRAM memory modules, compute and system-on-module solutions, AI accelerator modules, connectivity modules, and supporting software.

Our solutions are used in applications across networking and telecommunications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, medical, transportation, rugged computing, Industrial IoT, and other mission-critical embedded markets where reliability, lifecycle stability, qualification, and supply continuity matter.

Why This Role Matters

Virtium’s customers are navigating increasing complexity across embedded computing, Edge AI workloads, memory and storage requirements, semiconductor transitions, security expectations, and long product lifecycles. The Senior VP, Technology will help identify where customer requirements, emerging technologies, supplier roadmaps, and market opportunities intersect—and translate those insights into differentiated solutions, strategic partnerships, and scalable product opportunities.

The right leader will have the chance to influence Virtium’s technology direction at a meaningful stage of growth, with direct access to executive decision-making and a clear connection between strategy, customer need, product development, and market impact.

What You’ll Lead

Reporting to the CTO, the Senior VP, Technology will serve as Virtium’s senior technology strategist and trusted technical voice with customers, suppliers, partners, and internal teams. This leader will guide through technical credibility, strategic judgment, collaboration, and cross-functional influence while partnering closely with engineering leadership responsible for development execution.

Key Areas of Impact

Customer and Market Strategy: Build trusted-advisor relationships with strategic OEM customers, understand their embedded system architecture and future requirements, and identify where Virtium can create differentiated technical and commercial value.
Technology and Product Roadmap: Define and maintain Virtium’s long-term roadmap across industrial SSDs, DRAM memory, compute/SOM platforms, AI accelerator modules, connectivity modules, and related software-enabled solutions.
Technology Ecosystem Leadership: Develop strategic relationships with semiconductor manufacturers, processor and controller suppliers, memory and NAND partners, AI accelerator providers, connectivity partners, and other key technology ecosystem partners.
Architecture and Technical Direction: Guide major platform, architecture, and technology decisions across hardware, firmware, software, edge workload performance, system integration, thermal and power constraints, reliability, qualification, validation, and lifecycle requirements.
Executive Alignment and Growth: Align executive, commercial, product, engineering, operations, and supply chain teams around focused technology priorities that support customer value, differentiation, revenue growth, manufacturability, and time to market.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Executive-level technology leader with 15+ years of relevant experience in embedded systems, edge computing, memory, storage, semiconductors, computing hardware, connectivity, industrial hardware, or complex hardware/software platforms.
Strong customer-facing Senior VP, Technology, VP Engineering, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or senior technology leadership background with credibility across OEM customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and executive stakeholders.
Deep understanding of how to balance innovation with reliability, lifecycle stability, manufacturability, qualification, security, performance, and supply continuity in demanding embedded or mission-critical environments.
Proven ability to translate customer and market insight into technology roadmaps, scalable product opportunities, strategic partnerships, and practical execution priorities.
Comfortable operating in a hands-on, collaborative, growth-oriented environment where influence, clarity, judgment, and customer proximity matter.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline

Description

At Mission Rock Residential, we believe that where you live matters—and so does the team that makes it feel like home.

We are more than a property management company—we’re a people-first organization that values Integrity, Accountability, Respect, Relationships, Inclusivity, Vision, and Empathy. Our I ARRIVE values guide everything we do, from how we serve our residents to how we support our team members.

We foster an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse perspectives, empowers growth, and strengthens the communities we serve. When you join Mission Rock, you join a team that’s invested in your success and well-being.

The VP, Technology Strategy ensures the company’s technology ecosystem supports business strategy and delivers consistent, effective experience for team members, owners, and residents. The role maintains an enterprise-wide view of how systems connect, identifies opportunities to improve performance and usability, and partners with department leaders to align technology priorities with business needs.

Position Overview

This strategic, cross-functional leadership role is responsible for aligning the company’s enterprise application and software ecosystem with business strategy. The VP, Technology Strategy evaluates how property management software, CRM, accounting/ERP, revenue management, maintenance and work order platforms, resident experience applications, BI and reporting tools, and other systems work together to support company priorities rather than treating each platform as a stand-alone solution.

The VP, Technology Strategy, owns the roadmap for enterprise system initiatives and is accountable for how those initiatives are delivered. This includes prioritizing and sequencing projects against business need and capacity, defining scope and success measures with the sponsoring department, and keeping leadership current on progress, risk, and cost. Where implementations run through vendors or implementation partners, this role manages that relationship end to end: evaluating solutions, negotiating scope, holding partners to committed timelines and deliverables, and escalating when performance and adoption fall short.

Essential Functions Of The Job

This role leads the IT application team, partners with the company’s Advisory Team on enterprise technology priorities, and works with department leaders to drive implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role is measured by the delivery of prioritized initiatives on time and within approved scope and budget; increased adoption and effective use of enterprise systems; reduced system redundancy and manual work; improved data quality and integration; and measurable improvements to the team member, owner, and resident experience.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Role

The Technology team is responsible for the delivery, operation, and governance of secure, compliant, and scalable platforms that support critical healthcare services and enable the successful separation and long-term independence of the Ascendiun family of companies. The Director, Technology Transformation will report to the Chief Information Officer (CIO). In this role you will for lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale programs that create sustainable, systematic improvements across technology and business operations.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In This Role, You Will

Lead strategic technology initiatives that improve operational performance, scalability, reliability, and customer experience.
Identify systemic challenges and drive sustainable solutions that address root causes rather than symptoms.
Develop and execute transformation roadmaps aligned with business objectives and technology strategy.
Partner with business and technology leaders to drive organizational change and process improvements.
Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery teams.
Establish governance, milestones, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure program success.
Drive prioritization, issue resolution, risk management, and decision-making across initiatives.
Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business outcomes.
Lead efforts to improve system stability, service performance, operational maturity, and supportability.
Facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for recurring issues.
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product owners, and technology teams.
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
Requires a minimum of 10 years of technology experience, including 6+ years in leadership roles managing enterprise technology initiatives.
Proven experience leading large-scale technology programs and transformational initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, and operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and balancing competing priorities.

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

About Us

About Stellarus and the Ascendiun Family of Companies

Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors.

Stellarus is part of a family of organizations that is overseen by a nonprofit corporate entity named Ascendiun. The Ascendiun Family of Companies also includes Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan and Altais, a clinical services company.

Stellarus’ vision is to empower its customers to create a healthcare experience that is worthy of their family, friends, and neighbors. Stellarus’ objective is to offer innovative, modern, scalable solutions that challenge the health care status quo. This very closely aligns with Blue Shield of California’s vision by using innovation to improve quality, affordability, and experience for members.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Our Values

At Stellarus, our core values of agility, trust, drive, courage and service shape our approach to developing innovative product offerings.

Our Workplace Model

We believe in fostering a workplace environment that balances purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility - providing clear expectations while respecting the diverse needs of our workforce. Our workplace model is designed around intentional in-person interaction, collaboration, connection, creativity and flexibility:

For most teams, this means coming into the office two days per week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location, out of state employees, and employees in certain member-facing roles should work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
For employees with medical conditions that may impact their ability to work in-office, we are committed to engaging in an interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to ensure their work environment is conducive to their success and well-being.

The Company reserves the right to require more presence in the office based on business needs, and requirements are subject to change with periodic reviews.

Office Environment - roles involving part to full time schedule in Office Environment. Based in our physical offices and work from home office/deskwork - Activity level: Sedentary, frequency most of work day.

Please click here for further physical requirement detail.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability status and any other classification protected by Federal, State and local laws.

jobs.title: Director, Software Technical Product Management
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

Illumina's BioInsight Platform Core is the software foundation on which customers connect instruments, manage samples and projects, store and move data, run analysis workflows, and explore results — across cloud and on-prem deployments. As Director of Software Technical Product Management, BioInsight Platform Core Product, you own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery partnership for Platform Core: the application-facing capabilities historically delivered as Illumina Connected Analytics (ICA) and related platform surfaces.

You own instrument connectivity, data storage and data movement, workflow / pipeline execution, sample and project management, notebooks and interactive analysis, platform user experience, and APIs / developer experience — the product capabilities that make BioInsight Platform the durable home for Illumina software applications. You partner tightly with other software product leaders, as well as stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and Legal.

Scope of Responsibilities

Own BioInsight Platform Core product end-to-end: vision, multi-release roadmap, requirements quality, and release readiness for core platform capabilities
Lead a team of software technical product managers; hire, coach, and set the bar for platform product excellence
Serve as the primary product partner to platform engineering leadership on architecture bets, technical debt, reliability, performance, and security of core capabilities
Define outcome metrics for platform success: availability, time-to-first-analysis, workflow success rate, storage and data-movement reliability, notebook / interactive-analysis adoption, API adoption, and support burden
Ensure Platform Core meets enterprise and regulated-customer expectations for the capabilities it owns (security, privacy, auditability, quality-system interfaces where applicable)
Navigate ambiguity across a platform that serves many applications; create a coherent product narrative and prioritization framework
Represent BioInsight Platform Core in BioInsight leadership forums; escalate tradeoffs with clear recommendations

Responsibilities

Establish a multi-year roadmap for BioInsight Platform Core with clear problem statements and success metrics
Own product requirements for core platform capabilities, including: Instrument connectivity — sequencer and lab instrument connection, run data ingress, status, and operational reliability Data storage and data movement — customer data stores, import/export, retention/lifecycle behaviors that affect product experience (commercial storage packaging partners with Commercialization) Workflow and pipeline execution — defining, launching, monitoring, and operating analysis workflows at scale Sample and project management — organizing biological and analysis context that applications and workflows depend on Notebooks and interactive analysis — exploratory / interactive compute experiences on platform data Platform UX and APIs — console experience, developer surfaces, and integration contracts used by applications and customers
Partner with engineering leaders and architects to land technical bets safely; manage quality, cost, performance, and time tradeoffs
Lead customer and field discovery on core-product friction (instrument connection, storage/workflow failures, notebook UX, API gaps, cross-application platform gaps); synthesize into prioritized bets
Align with application TPMs (DRAGEN, Oncology / ICI, Genetic Disease, Multiomics, Orchestration) so Platform Core investments unlock portfolio-level outcomes
Partner with the Commercialization Director at the boundary where core capabilities meet commercial systems (e.g., storage tiers that are sold, workflow compute that is metered) — Commercialization owns tenancy, IAM, entitlements, usage metering, and billing; Core owns the product capability customers use
Define and review launch and post-market quality plans for Platform Core releases; engage Quality/Security/Privacy as needed
Instrument core capabilities for product telemetry; drive iteration loops that improve adoption and reduce support load
Support strategic customer engagements where Platform Core architecture, roadmap, or reliability is decisive
Build and develop the core product team; raise the bar on PRDs, documentation, and cross-functional working agreements

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Experience / Education

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 18 years of related experience in a technical field (computer science, bioinformatics, engineering, life sciences, or related) or equivalent experience; advanced degree a plus
Typically 12+ years of progressive experience in product management for scientific, data, or analysis platforms (workflow/pipeline systems, data platforms, instrument-to-cloud software, or developer-facing platforms), with 5+ years leading managers or senior ICs
Track record shipping platform capabilities at scale — e.g., storage/data services, workflow orchestration or pipeline execution, notebooks / interactive compute, instrument or device connectivity, or APIs used by multiple consuming applications
Experience in life sciences, health tech, genomics, or regulated software strongly preferred; prior ICA, BaseSpace, or equivalent genomics-platform experience is a significant plus
Comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, SLAs, and security with engineering leaders
Strong executive communication skills; ability to create clarity under ambiguity
Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP and with hybrid / on-prem deployment models is a plus

Requirements

Proven ability to craft platform strategy, translate it into roadmaps, and ship iteratively
Experience collaborating with engineering, design/UX, security, quality, and commercial teams
Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle; design controls / ISO 13485 experience a plus where platform touches regulated workflows
Ability to balance the needs of many consuming products without becoming a pure intake function
Experience building or scaling a product management team; mentoring senior PMs
Analytical rigor: product telemetry, reliability and workflow success metrics, adoption funnels, prioritization frameworks

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities.

The estimated base salary range for the Director, Software Technical Product Management role based in the United States of America is: $205,100 - $307,700. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off.

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected or the requisition has a sufficient number of qualified applicants. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
