jobs.description:
At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose.

Position Overview:

Do you want your engineering leadership to shape how an entire enterprise puts generative AI to work — safely, at scale, and for real impact? At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is at the core of everything we do, and our Corporate Technology Strategy team is building FredAI, our internal enterprise GenAI platform and portfolio of AI-enabled products. We're searching for a hands-on, visionary engineering leader to own the technical strategy and delivery that turns cutting-edge foundation models into measurable business outcomes. Apply now and learn why there's #MoreAtFreddieMac!

Our Impact:

We build the secure, scalable platforms and reusable services that bring generative AI capabilities — including the company's internal chatbot and AI-enabled products — to teams across the enterprise.
We translate the Freddie Mac CIO vision for GenAI into an executable engineering roadmap, setting the reference architectures, standards, and shared frameworks that let multiple product teams deliver consistently and responsibly.
We partner across Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data, Model Risk, and Cloud Engineering to ensure every solution meets enterprise expectations for identity, data protection, auditability, resiliency, and responsible AI.

Your Impact:

In this role, you will be an integral part of our GenAI engineering leadership and will be expected to:

Lead the end-to-end engineering strategy, architecture, and delivery of FredAI, building production GenAI applications using foundation models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, orchestration, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
Build a reusable platform of reference architectures, SDKs, shared services, APIs, and integration patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple product teams.
Implement rigorous evaluation, testing, and LLMOps practices — offline benchmarks, regression suites, groundedness and hallucination measures, CI/CD, versioning, observability, tracing, incident response, and rollback.
Engineer secure, permission-aware solutions that enforce identity, entitlements, data boundaries, privacy, human approvals, audit logging, and responsible AI policies.
Define model and platform integration patterns, including model selection and routing, structured outputs, caching, rate limiting, fallback strategies, token budgets, circuit-breaker controls, and cost management.
Partner with cloud, platform, data, and security teams, and with the GenAI Program Manager, to integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems and translate business needs into governed, high-value capabilities.
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of GenAI, software, platform, and quality engineers, setting clear expectations, career paths, and a culture of ownership and experimentation.
Manage engineering and product-quality outcomes — availability, latency, throughput, task completion, adoption, developer productivity, and cost per successful outcome.

Qualifications:

15+ years of software, data, or machine learning engineering experience, including significant technical and people leadership responsibility (4+ years leading engineering teams/managers).
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience (advanced degree preferred).
Proven experience architecting and delivering production GenAI or AI/ML systems at enterprise scale, with recent hands-on coding experience.
Strong proficiency in modern cloud-native engineering (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java; APIs, microservices, containers, distributed systems, CI/CD, IaC).
Hands-on knowledge of LLM application patterns — prompting, RAG, embeddings, vector search, orchestration, tool calling, agents, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
Experience designing for security, privacy, identity, data governance, resiliency, auditability, and responsible AI in a regulated enterprise environment.

Keys to Success in this Role:

A builder's mindset — you love solving the hardest engineering problems hands-on, not just directing from the sidelines.
A natural influencer who can rally engineering, security, data, risk, and business partners around a shared technical vision.
Comfortable operating in the space of "no longer" and "not yet" — translating fast-moving GenAI advances into practical, governed capabilities.
Calm under pressure, with strong operational discipline and a bias toward measurable outcomes.
A curious, continuous learner who stays current on emerging AI technologies — and a great teammate with a sense of humor.

Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the next generation of cloud services that power mission-critical workloads for customers around the world. OCI combines the speed, ownership, and innovation of a startup with the scale, reliability, and customer focus of one of the world’s leading technology companies.

Oracle Managed Kubernetes (OMK) is Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's (OCI) enterprise-grade Kubernetes service that provides a managed, scalable, and secure environment to deploy containerized applications. It is built on the open-source Kubernetes engine and designed to simplify operations, improve performance, and provide deep integration with the broader OCI ecosystem.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on senior engineering manager to manage and grow a team of highly talented engineers responsible for designing, building, and operating software systems for OMK. You will own delivery, architecture, reliability, and operational health across multiple software areas while developing strong engineering leaders and technical talent.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader with a strong background in distributed systems, cloud services, operational platforms, and people leadership. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-scale environments, driving technical strategy, building durable teams, and partnering across engineering, product, operations, and infrastructure organizations to deliver measurable business impact.

This is an opportunity to lead teams building software that directly improves how OCI supports global data center infrastructure, reduces operational friction, increases automation, and enables OCI to scale efficiently.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams.
Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk.
Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements.
Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project.
Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas.
Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions.
Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

Continuous Learning:

Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

Continuous Improvement:

Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

jobs.title: Director, Ceramic Technology
jobs.description:
At Utility, we’re reimagining what’s possible.
Our breakthrough H2Gen® technology transforms undesirable industrial by-products into clean energy and sustainable fuels and feedstocks, helping hard-to-abate industries decarbonize without compromise. We’re building systems and solutions that will power a zero-carbon future by turning what the world doesn’t want into clean energy it needs most.
But technology alone doesn’t change the world.
People do.

We’re building a team as bold as our mission. Engineers and scientists, designers and operators, storytellers and strategists all united by a shared belief: that the undesirable can become invaluable, and that industrial decarbonization can be both practical and economical.
At Utility, we see possibilities where others see limits. We believe progress happens when diverse minds collaborate toward a cleaner, smarter, more resilient world.
If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, join us and help build what’s next.
The Company

Utility Global
is redefining how the world makes and uses energy. Through its breakthrough H₂Gen® technology
, Utility transforms industrial off-gases and biogases into clean energy and sustainable fuels and feedstocks, helping industries decarbonize without compromise
. The company’s proprietary technology delivers a scalable, economic pathway to a zero-carbon future, positioning Utility as a leader in the industrial decarbonization revolution.
The Role

Utility Global is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director, Ceramic Technology
to lead our Applied Technology ceramic development team in Englewood, Colorado. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader will set priorities, guide technical strategy, and develop the people, processes, and roadmap needed to advance ceramic materials and manufacturing technologies for high-temperature reactor components.
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in ceramic materials and processing with proven experience leading technical teams in fast-paced R&D, pilot-scale, or manufacturing environments. This person should be comfortable translating business and technology objectives into a clear team strategy, making disciplined tradeoffs, mentoring engineers and scientists, and ensuring experimental work leads to actionable decisions and scalable process improvements.
This is a technical leadership role with accountability for both forward-looking ceramic technology development and practical manufacturing readiness. Experience in electrochemical systems is welcome, but strong leadership in ceramic materials, processing, characterization, scale-up, and technology transfer is more important than electrochemistry domain knowledge for this position.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, manage, and develop a team responsible for ceramic materials, bodies, coatings, and processes for high-temperature reactor components.
Set technical priorities, allocate resources, and translate company objectives into a focused ceramic technology roadmap.
Define and guide experimental strategy to improve performance, durability, manufacturability, quality, and cost.
Oversee the translation of bench-scale ceramic development into robust pilot-scale and manufacturing-relevant processes.
Build decision-making frameworks for powder handling, mixing, dispersion, rheology, forming, drying, thermal treatment, inspection, and related process steps.
Partner cross-functionally with R&D, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and external partners to select, evaluate, and qualify ceramic materials and processes.
Establish clear technical standards for testing, characterization, data analysis, documentation, and design reviews.
Guide troubleshooting and root-cause investigations for process and equipment issues affecting quality, yield, consistency, and throughput.
Support technology transfer and manufacturing readiness internally and with third-party production partners.
Communicate strategy, progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to the CTO, leadership team, technical colleagues, and external stakeholders.
Ensure team activities are conducted safely and in compliance with internal procedures and relevant standards.

This role will focus primarily on building and leading a forward-looking ceramic technology function, with ongoing accountability for manufacturing support, technology transfer, and scale-up readiness across both in-house and third-party production.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

BS in Ceramic Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
8+ years of relevant industrial experience, including demonstrated leadership of technical teams; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience leading ceramic materials, processing, manufacturing development, or scale-up programs in an industrial environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage, coach, and develop engineers, scientists, technicians, or cross-functional technical contributors.
Hands-on familiarity with ceramic processing methods such as extrusion, slip casting, spray coating, isostatic pressing, tape casting, dip coating, gel casting, or related forming and coating processes.
Strong working knowledge of relevant characterization techniques such as dilatometry, rheometry, particle size analysis, SEM, XRD, BET, porosimetry, TGA/DSC, mechanical testing, fractography, or digital image analysis.
Experience applying DOE, statistical methods, root-cause analysis, process qualification, or similar tools to guide technical decisions and process improvement.
Ability to communicate complex technical strategy, risks, and recommendations clearly to executive leadership and technical teams.
Ability to lead effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional R&D environment with evolving priorities and high ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications:

MS or PhD in Ceramic Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
Prior ownership of a ceramic technology roadmap, platform development program, or multi-year scale-up initiative.
Experience transferring technology from R&D into pilot-scale, internal manufacturing, or third-party manufacturing environments.
Prior experience in aerospace, defense, structural ceramics, refractories, filtration, catalyst supports, thermal management, nuclear materials, or other advanced ceramic manufacturing environments.
Experience establishing technical governance, design review processes, quality gates, or process qualification methods for complex hardware or materials systems.

jobs.title: Hiring Event - Chief Software Engineer V
jobs.description:
Overview

Great minds meet great challenges.

Ready to build what’s next?

At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget.

Our Science & Technology directorates include National Security, Integrated Discovery Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus.

The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science-based, mission-focused solutions to take on complex, real-world threats to our nation and the world.

The AI and Data Analytics Division, part of NSD, combines profound domain expertise and creative integration of advanced hardware and software to deliver computational solutions that address complex data and analytic challenges. Working in multidisciplinary teams, we connect foundational research to engineering to operations, providing the tools to innovate quickly and field results faster. Our strengths are integrated across the data analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and management to analysis and decision support.

Event Details

Our hiring event will take place during the weeks of October 12th to November 13th.

Selected candidates may be invited to participate in virtual and onsite interviews during this timeframe and will be contacted directly with scheduling details.

This role is performed full-time onsite at the PNNL campus in Richland, WA or Seattle, WA.

Responsibilities

With new projects and expanding programs, our AI and Data Analytics Division offers opportunities to advance cutting-edge research and build solutions for critical national security missions. Join a team of more than 400 data scientists, software engineers, mathematicians, and human-centered computing researchers turning ambitious ideas into real-world capabilities.

We're hiring across three complementary chief engineering tracks
, and we're looking for people who want to own something meaningful end-to-end: from the platform beneath it, to the systems that power it, to the experience humans actually touch.

Skills We’re Seeking

DevSecOps and Platform Engineering: Design and build scalable AI platforms, cloud-native infrastructure, containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, IaC, real-time data stream architectures, and reliable, secure production systems. We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Python expertise and significant experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, distributed systems, telemetry and observability, security, and automated software delivery.
AI Systems & Data Platform Software Engineers: Push the boundaries of agentic AI systems characterized by autonomy, adaptability, reasoning, collaboration, and effective tool use. We are seeking experienced software engineers and nationally recognized technical leaders who have designed and deployed agentic AI systems and large-scale data platforms in real-world environments. Relevant expertise includes large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step reasoning, autonomous decision workflows, model and data orchestration, production-quality AI systems, and designing and operating petabyte-scale ETL/ELT pipelines. Senior candidates may also shape research directions, lead multidisciplinary R&D programs, develop external partnerships, and mentor AI scientists and engineers.

Learn more about the PNNL AI and Data Analytics Division.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

PhD and 5 years of relevant experience -OR-
MS/MA and 7 years of relevant experience -OR-
BS/BA and 9 years of relevant experience -OR-
AA and 18 years of relevant experience -OR-
HS/GED and 20 years of relevant experience.
Relevant experience is defined as Software Engineering experience in designing, architecting, programming, deploying, and automating software solutions in support of scientific research or consumer digital product development.

Current, hands-on software development experience using Python.

Hazardous Working Conditions/Environment

Not applicable.

Additional Information

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance.

A security clearance background investigation includes review of your employment, education, financial, and criminal history, as well as interviews with you and your personal references, neighbors, and co-workers to determine trustworthiness, reliability, and loyalty to the United States. The investigation also examines your foreign connections, drug and alcohol use, foreign influence, and overall conduct.

Requirements

U.S. Citizenship
Background Investigation: Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter in accordance with 10 CFR 710, Appendix B.
Drug Testing: All Security Clearance positions are Testing Designated Positions, which means that the applicant selected for hire is subject to pre-employment drug testing, and post-employment random drug testing. In addition, applicants must be able to demonstrate non-use of illegal drugs, including marijuana, for the 12 consecutive months preceding completion of the requisite Questionnaire for National Security Positions (QNSP).

Note: Applicants will be considered ineligible for security clearance processing by the U.S. Department of Energy if non-use of illegal drugs, including marijuana, for 12 months cannot be demonstrated.

“Referral Eligible”

Testing Designated Position

This position is a Testing Designated Position (TDP). The candidate selected for this position will be subject to pre-employment and random drug testing for illegal drugs, including marijuana, consistent with the Controlled Substances Act and the PNNL Workplace Substance Abuse Program.

About PNNL

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them!

At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45-minute flight (or ~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs.

Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity

Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov.

Drug Free Workplace

PNNL is committed to a drug-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs.

If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn.

Security, Credentialing, And Eligibility Requirements

As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

For Foreign National Candidates

If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three-year residency requirement thereafter, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

Mandatory Requirements

Please be aware that the Department of Energy (DOE) prohibits DOE employees and contractors from having any affiliation with the foreign government of a country DOE has identified as a “country of risk” without explicit approval by DOE and Battelle. If you are offered a position at PNNL and currently have any affiliation with the government of one of these countries, you will be required to disclose this information and recuse yourself of that affiliation or receive approval from DOE and Battelle prior to your first day of employment.

Employees are automatically enrolled in our company-funded pension plan* and may enroll in our 401 (k) savings plan with company match*. Employees may accrue up to 120 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year.

Research Associates excluded.
All benefits are dependent upon eligibility.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Being at the forefront of innovation is exciting, and leading transformation in a large global organization is a role that many people aspire to. If this is you, we have a transformational role in our newly developed platform services organization. We’re looking for a transformational leader in our technology services hub focused on marketing technologies.

The Senior Director, Software Engineering, is the senior technology leader accountable for end-to-end
product development across the entire global MarTech, AdTech, Customer, and Commercial portfolio .
This leader owns engineering strategy and execution for all products and platforms in the portfolio, supporting customer experience, service experience across all regions (North America, LATAM, EMEA, APAC).

This is a foundational leadership role with the mandate, resources, and executive support to build and run a modern, durable product engineering organization on a global scale. The leader directs a scaled engineering organization of 250+ associates and contractors
operating within a modern Product Operating Model and is accountable for the resilience, scalability, and performance of platforms that directly impact consumer engagement, commercial performance, and data-driven decision-making worldwide.

This role requires a combination of deep technical authority and product orientation. The ideal leader is someone with strong engineering foundations who can move seamlessly from executive strategy conversations to architecture reviews and who will get hands-on and into technology when it matters. Above all, this is a steady, calm voice that leads to a large, globally distributed team through complexity and change.

A defining priority of this role is to lead the organization in leveraging Generative AI capabilities
across the full software development lifecycle and product portfolio, advancing the team from AI-assisted workflows toward AI-enabled delivery and decisioning at scale, responsibly and with measurable business value.

This leader oversees end-to-end product development for a cluster of products within the MarTech, AdTech, Customer, and Commercial portfolio.

Our Senior Directors, Directors, and Managers across the product engineering teams report to this role. This role reports to the Vice President, Platform & Product Engineering, and partners closely with the Senior Directors across Platform, Operations, and Architecture.

What You’ll Do for Us:

Engineering Leadership & Organizational Excellence

Lead and develop a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization under the Product Operating Model, with clear accountability for product and platform outcomes across all MarTech and AdTech products.

Build empowered teams that own business problems end to end, from discovery through delivery, operation, and continuous improvement.

Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent and leaders, creating a culture of technical excellence, craftsmanship, accountability, and continuous learning.

Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, and accountability frameworks aligned to business outcomes rather than project completion.

Product Development Ownership Across the Global Portfolio

Own end-to-end development for the entire MarTech and AdTech product portfolio globally, ensuring every product is delivered with quality, reliability, and speed.

Partner closely with Product Management and Product Design in a durable one-team model to solve meaningful business problems.

Drive accountability for measurable outcomes, including business impact, system reliability, performance, scalability, and consumer experience.

Technical Strategy & Architecture Leadership

Define and evolve the technical strategy, architecture, and engineering practices required for scalable, resilient, and secure product platforms at a global scale.

Provide technical oversight for critical systems and platform investments, staying close enough to the technology to lead by substance.

Balance build vs. buy trade-offs with rigor and a long-term view, ensuring systems are built for durability, operability, and speed.

Ensure systems are designed for scale, resiliency, and long-term sustainability, balancing delivery speed with technical excellence.

Generative AI Leadership & Enablement

Champion the adoption of Generative AI and agentic capabilities
across the full SDLC and product portfolio, positioning AI as a core driver of developer velocity, decision quality and operational efficiency.

Drive team readiness for AI-augmented work, including workforce and process redesign and change enablement, equipping teams to operate effectively in an AI-enabled environment.

Executive Engagement & Strategic Influence

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior business and technology leaders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business implications.

Communicate engineering strategy, risks, tradeoffs, and investment needs to executive stakeholders with clarity and credibility.

Influence enterprise technology direction, ensuring alignment across product engineering, enterprise architecture, and business strategy, and participate in executive planning cycles.

Qualifications & Requirements 

Leadership & Product Model Experience

15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including senior leadership roles and meaningful hands-on time building scalable solutions; ideally began as a developer and grew into a technology thought leader.

5+ years leading engineering organizations within a Product Operating Model or equivalent modern product-centric environment.

5+ years leading engineering through organizational transformation and modernization at scale.

10+ years building and scaling high-performing engineering teams, including leading other leaders (managers and Tech leads).

Strong partnership experience with Product Management and Product Design in empowered team environments.

Technical Depth

Deep expertise in modern software architecture, distributed systems, and platform engineering, with the ability to engage engineers credibly on design and tradeoffs and to get hands-on when needed.

Strong command of cloud architectures (AWS / Azure), scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence.

Track record delivering complex, enterprise-scale platforms and systems, ideally across MarTech / AdTech and consumer-facing digital products.

Generative AI Leadership

Demonstrated experience leading AI or GenAI enablement within products or platform environments, with measurable business impact.

Familiarity with modern AI/ML platforms, LLM integration and agentic patterns, RAG, and the architectural and governance requirements for scalable, governed AI deployment.

Proven ability to drive workforce and process transformation in support of AI-augmented development and decision making.

Executive Communication & Leadership Presence

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to senior executives and business stakeholders, and to influence enterprise technology strategy.

Strong business acumen connecting engineering investments to measurable business outcomes.

A calm, steady leadership style that brings clarity under pressure and earns trust across a large, globally distributed, multi-vendor organization.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and demonstrated professional experience will also be considered.

What We’ll Do For You

Exposure to World-Class Leaders: Availability to global technology leaders will expand your network and expose you to emerging technologies and techniques. 

Global Connections: Allows you to develop, enhance and maintain global connections that allow us to move faster and learn from others.  

Agile Work Environment: We embrace agile, with management that believes in removing barriers, so you are empowered to experiment, iterate, and innovate

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager IT Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
We are constantly looking to add to our core talent. If you are seeking a career that is challenging and rewarding, a work environment that is diverse and dynamic, look no further — Haemonetics is your employer of choice.

Job Details

The Senior Manager, Information Technology Infrastructure leads the strategy, delivery, security, reliability, and continuous improvement of the organization’s enterprise infrastructure services. This role manages infrastructure operations across cloud and on-premises environments, including compute, storage, customer-facing hosting platforms, data centers, backup and recovery, and end-user technology services. The Senior Manager partners with business and technology leaders to translate organizational needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions while developing a high-performing technical team and ensuring operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure strategy: Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure roadmap aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity requirements, and financial objectives.
Service ownership: Ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and supportability of cloud, network, server, storage, identity, collaboration, backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint services.
Operational excellence: Establish service-level objectives, operational metrics, monitoring, incident response, problem management, change management, capacity planning, patching, lifecycle management, and continuous-improvement practices.
Cybersecurity and compliance: Partner with information security, risk, privacy, and compliance teams to implement required controls, remediate vulnerabilities, support audits, and maintain secure configurations.
Cloud and modernization: Lead cloud adoption, automation, standardization, technical-debt reduction, and modernization initiatives while optimizing performance, resilience, and cost.
Business continuity: Maintain tested backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities; define recovery objectives and coordinate exercises and remediation activities.
People leadership: Hire, coach, develop, and retain infrastructure professionals; establish clear objectives, accountability, succession plans, and development opportunities.
Financial and vendor management: Own budgets, forecasts, licensing, asset lifecycle plans, contracts, sourcing activities, and supplier performance; identify opportunities to improve value and reduce total cost of ownership.
Stakeholder partnership: Communicate service health, risks, priorities, and investment needs to technical and nontechnical leaders; collaborate across applications, security, data, facilities, and business functions.
Governance and documentation: Maintain standards, procedures, architecture documentation, support models, inventories, and decision records that enable reliable and repeatable service delivery.
Escalation leadership: Provide executive-level coordination during critical incidents, ensure timely communications, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, AWS, Veeam, Linux, PDQ or VMware.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure.
Experience supporting regulated & controlled environments (life sciences, healthcare).
10 + years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments., operations, engineering, or service delivery,
5+ years in a people-management role. Talent development and team leadership
Strong knowledge of networking, compute, storage, virtualization, identity and access management, enterprise collaboration, backup and recovery, monitoring, endpoint management, and infrastructure automation.
Experience leading IT service management and infrastructure operations and complex infrastructure transformations.
Proven ability to manage budgets, forecasts, contracts & external providers.
Strategic thinking and disciplined execution
Customer and business orientation
Sound judgment, ownership, and accountability
Clear communication and stakeholder influence
Risk awareness and continuous improvement
Collaboration across technical and business teams

Additional Requirements

May require participation in an on-call escalation rotation and availability outside normal business hours for critical incidents or planned maintenance.
Periodic travel may be required to company sites, data centers, or supplier locations.
Works in a hybrid office and remote environment, subject to organizational policy and business needs.

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this role is:

$124,300.00-$211,700.00/Annual

The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account, without limitation, the candidate’s location, education, job-knowledge, skills, and experience in prior relevant roles.

Incentives may also be provided as part of Haemonetics’ employee compensation. For sales roles
, employees will be eligible for sales incentive (i.e., commission) under the applicable plan terms. For non-sales roles
, employees will be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, the target amount of which varies based on the applicable role, to be governed by the applicable plan terms. Employees may also be eligible to participate in the Company’s long-term incentive plan, with eligibility and target amount dependent on the role.

In addition to compensation, the Company offers a competitive suite of benefits to its employees, including without limitation, a 401(k) with up to a 6% employer match and no vesting period, an employee stock purchase plan, “flexible time off” for salaried employees and, for hourly employees, accrual of three to five weeks’ vacation annually (based on tenure), accrual of up to 64 hours (annually) of paid sick time, paid and/or floating holidays, parental leave, short- and long-term disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and/or health and welfare benefits.

Depending on your location, you may be eligible for more detailed information related to the compensation and benefits related to this job posting. If you believe you may be entitled to such information by law, you may contact 1-781-348-7777, Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. – 5 p.m. ET or email AskHR@Haemonetics.com.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Blackstone Law is growing fast. With nearly 50 attorneys, we’ve become one of California’s leading plaintiff side employment law firms, representing employees in individual and class action employment matters.

We’ve built a fast-moving, technology driven firm that combines experienced legal judgment with technology and automation to work smarter and deliver better outcomes for our clients. We’re looking for talented CTO Professional who are excited about the opportunity to help us grow our presence in a new market.

Our culture is collaborative, comfortable, and performance driven. We work hard, support one another, and believe you can do exceptional work while still having a life outside of it. We’re a family that values each person’s contribution and invests in their growth.

About the Role

Blackstone Law is looking for a forward-thinking, hands-on Chief Technology Officer to lead the next phase of our technology strategy.

We have already made significant investments in technology, AI, automation, and data. We’re looking for an experienced technology leader who will take us to the next level.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role. We need someone who understands how AI, data, software, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and automation work together—and can translate those capabilities into measurable improvements in how a modern law firm operates.

The CTO will partner directly with executive leadership while providing technical direction and accountability to our internal and external technology resources.

While we are primarily seeking a full-time CTO, we are open to considering the right candidate on a fractional basis initially.

What You’ll Do

Own and execute the firm’s technology, AI, data, and infrastructure strategy.

Assess our current technology environment, architecture, systems, integrations, vendors, and development initiatives and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities.

Lead the firm’s AI strategy, including the evaluation, development, implementation, and governance of AI-powered tools and workflows.

Provide technical leadership and accountability for developers, IT resources, consultants, and technology vendors.

Establish clear expectations around project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and performance.

Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve productivity, strengthen knowledge management, and better leverage firm data.

Ensure our technology environment is secure, scalable, reliable, and positioned to support continued growth.

Oversee cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risk.

Evaluate emerging technologies based on practical business value—not technology for technology’s sake.

Partner with the Leadership, attorneys, and operational leaders to translate business needs into practical technology solutions.

Own technology budgeting and help leadership make informed investment decisions.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including CTO, CIO, VP/Head of Technology, or comparable leadership experience.
Proven experience building and executing technology strategies within a growing organization.
Strong technical knowledge across AI, data architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems integration, and software development.
Hands-on experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI and automation solutions.
Experience leading developers, engineers, IT professionals, vendors, and outsourced technology resources.
Ability to quickly assess an existing technology environment and determine what should be scaled, improved, replaced, or rebuilt.
Strong execution and project-management discipline with a track record of turning strategy into measurable results.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical executives and business leaders.
Experience working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial organization.
Law firm or legal technology experience preferred; professional services experience is also highly valued.

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Development
new_jobs.description:
Overview

SitelogIQ
is a world-class team making a large-scale impact on the efficiency and sustainability of the places we live, work, shop, and heal.

SitelogIQ delivers turnkey solutions across energy efficiency: lighting upgrades
, EV infrastructure
, solar and energy storage system
[distributed generation (DG)] , and other facility improvement measures (FIMs)
that transform built environments and breathe life into the sustainability, financial, and resiliency goals of real estate teams, corporations and public sector organizations across the U.S. Our mission is to make buildings better while making it easy for our clients to accelerate their impact.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering & Development for Distributed Generation
within our Commercial Markets Division
provides strategic leadership and oversight of the project engineering and development function and team. This role establishes departmental priorities and standards across team management, tools and systems, project scope development, engineering execution, budget estimating, scheduling, quality, risk management, and workflow.

Key Components Of This Role Include

Management: Strategic leadership and management of the DG team, including Project Development Engineers; oversight of resource planning, project priorities, workflows, day-to-day operations, training and mentoring, performance, and continuous improvement.
Project Engineering & Development: Direct, facilitate, and/or review site survey [audit] analysis, conceptual project designs, estimating, schedules, product specifications, code research and application, and the preparation of proposal documents.

An effective SitelogIQ Director of Engineering & Development will partner with leaders across Sales, Operations, and Project Management and represent the team and its technical solutions to clients and their technical staff. They will oversee program and project development milestones to deliver timely, comprehensive proposals that clearly communicate project intentions and solutions while meeting SitelogIQ financial and risk metrics. SitelogIQ team members are expected to share knowledge with others by serving as a constant contributor, trainer, mentor, and resource.

Target Salary:
$145,000 - $180,000 dependent on experience.

Director, Engineering & Development Responsibilities

Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to the team as they develop and produce DG project designs and proposals.
Oversee the internal proposal queue, resource allocation, team assignments, risk review process, and client commitments.
Facilitate collaboration between the Engineering & Development and Sales teams to determine customers’ specific technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product feature needs.
Establish and maintain quality standards for project designs, submittals, and permitting packages.
Lead the development of new processes, tools, and workflows and the continuous improvement of existing practices.
Partner with Sales to define customers’ technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product or system feature needs.
Participate in site-surveys, pre-bid and pre-construction meetings as needed; noting that SitelogIQ’s commercial markets team does have an Assessment team devoted to supporting all types of site-surveys including DG projects.
Maintain all internal documentation in a collaborative file sharing and storage environment.
Lead technical strategy and support for large RFP and business development opportunities.
Participate in quality control review of peer project development team
Ensure effective coordination of installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives and support field installation when needed.
Oversee the evaluation of site audits and selection of product solutions that provide clients with the optimal balance of functionality, long-term operating expense, aesthetics, and constructability.
Establish quality control standards and review submittal packages (product data sheets; bill of materials; standard and customer drawings; layout and connection detail drawings; return on investment analysis; etc.) for content accuracy and alignment with proposal goals.
Review and markup drawings for typical product applications
Review and present DG solution proposals
Ensure local jurisdiction code compliance research is completed and incorporated into project solutions.
Partner with construction leaders to establish accurate project cost estimates.
Establish design intent and specifications and ensure the team consistently meets them.
Provide technical leadership for large RFP and business development opportunities, including the creation of detailed submittal packages.
Coordinate installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives. Support field installation when needed
Lead quality control reviews of projects
Any, and all ad hoc reporting, requests or other tasks deemed

Director, Engineering & Development Requirements & Qualifications

Industry experience and credentials required:
At least 10 years of progressive experience in engineering, project development, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading, managing, and developing a team.

Active Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with the ability to obtain additional licenses through comity as required.
Experience understanding audit and field survey data and translating that into design documents and drawings.
Experience performing sales liaison and client collaboration in energy or related industries.
Strong understanding of DG systems and corresponding customer requirements.
Excellent understanding of financial business principles.
Adept at project scheduling, task definition and effort estimation.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects from concept through completion.
Strong design evaluation, documentation writing skills, problem solving skills, and attention to detail.
Professional communication and presentation skills.
Must be able to work independently, with minimal supervision under time sensitive deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.
Experience with file sharing, document management and collaboration tools.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This position operates in both office and field settings. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, talk, hear, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, phone, and keyboard. May regularly need to lift up to 20 lbs., unassisted. Travel will be required for site assessments and customer presentations.

Benefits

We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Disability and life insurance
401K
Flex time off
12 paid holidays
Tuition reimbursement
Opportunities to drive our DE&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization, or Women Inspiring & Strengthening Everyone
Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers

More About SitelogIQ

At SitelogIQ, we’re focused on creating a great environment for our team first so that it is more energizing and rewarding to focus on creating great customer experience. That’s what we call a win-win.

We partner with clients in K-12, higher ed, government, healthcare, multifamily housing, and industry to optimize energy efficiency, improve indoor air quality, address lighting, and improve the customer experience. With offices across the country, it’s rewarding to make a difference in the communities where our teammates live and work.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may be asked to perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the Organization .

SitelogIQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in the E-Verify program.

new_jobs.title: Internal Only: Director of Programs and Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Director of Programs and Engineering - X-Bow Solid Rocket Motor Division

Company Overview

X-Bow Launch Systems, Inc. (pronounced "Crossbow") is a U.S. defense technology and rocket propulsion company that has developed an innovative, low-cost method to manufacture solid rocket motors. Our propulsion technology, space launch capabilities, and modular boost platforms make us unique and highly desirable aerospace supplier to the defense and national security industries.

Position Summary

X-Bow is seeking an exceptional Director of Programs and Engineering to join our Defense Systems Sector. Reporting directly to the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production, this senior leadership position will provide strategic direction and operational oversight for both program management and engineering functions. This role requires a dynamic leader capable of bridging technical excellence with program execution, managing multiple rocket motor development and production programs from initial customer interaction through final delivery while simultaneously leading engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions on accelerated timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Provide strategic direction and leadership for integrated program management and engineering operations across the Defense Systems Sector

Support the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production in developing and executing organizational strategy

Drive alignment between engineering capabilities and program requirements to ensure successful delivery

Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across programs and engineering teams

Program Management Leadership

Direct and oversee multiple rocket motor development and production programs simultaneously

Develop comprehensive program portfolios that outline goals, timelines, resources, and budget requirements across all programs

Ensure programs are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while maintaining technical excellence

Serve as senior escalation point for program challenges and strategic customer engagements

Lead proposal development efforts and strategic customer interactions

Engineering Leadership

Provide technical leadership and direction for SRM Engineering and SRM Mechanical Engineering teams

Ensure engineering deliverables meet rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation requirements for solid rocket motors

Drive technical innovation in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing processes

Balance engineering resources across multiple programs to optimize technical outcomes and schedule performance

Establish and maintain engineering standards, processes, and best practices

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams across Solid Large Motor Programs, Small Motor Programs, SRM Engineering, SRM Mechanical Engineering, Business Management, and Production

Manage and develop program managers and engineering leaders within the organization

Collaborate effectively with Program Scheduling, Production Scheduling, Logistics, EHS, and Quality Management functions

Build and maintain high-performing teams capable of executing on compressed timelines

Stakeholder Communication and Engagement

Serve as a senior point of contact for critical program stakeholders, including executives, government representatives, and external partners

Communicate program and engineering status, challenges, and outcomes to the VP and senior leadership

Maintain transparency and collaboration across all organizational interfaces

Represent X-Bow at customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry forums

Risk Management and Problem Solving

Identify, analyze, and mitigate strategic and technical risks across the program portfolio

Resolve complex technical and programmatic issues, applying advanced problem-solving skills

Proactively address challenges related to requirements, technical development, and manufacturing

Implement risk mitigation strategies that protect program objectives and organizational interests

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Ensure all program and engineering activities comply with organizational standards, industry regulations, and government requirements

Implement quality assurance processes to maintain the highest standards in program deliverables

Oversee rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation of solid rocket motors

Work closely with Quality Management and EHS teams to ensure compliance and safety across all operations

Resource Management and Business Operations

Manage departmental budgets and resources effectively to meet organizational objectives

Optimize resource allocation across programs and engineering functions

Support business development activities and strategic growth initiatives

Drive operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness while maintaining technical excellence

Continuous Improvement

Evaluate program and engineering performance and identify areas for improvement

Implement best practices and lessons learned into future programs and engineering processes

Champion organizational learning and knowledge management initiatives

Contribute to the advancement of X-Bow's innovative manufacturing methodologies

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, or related field) required

Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field strongly preferred

Experience

Minimum of 10-12 years of progressive experience in the aerospace or defense industry

Minimum of 5-7 years in leadership roles managing programs and/or engineering teams

Extensive experience in program or project management, with demonstrated success managing complex, multi-million dollar programs

Strong technical expertise in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing highly desired

Proven experience in proposal development and management in the aerospace/defense sector

Experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent programs

Track record of successful customer engagement and relationship management with government and commercial clients

Skills and Competencies

Exceptional leadership and people management skills with ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams

Deep understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and tools (Agile, Waterfall, Earned Value Management)

Strong technical acumen with ability to make sound engineering and programmatic decisions

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term vision with near-term execution

Proven ability to work independently and make decisions with minimal oversight in fast-paced environments

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under compressed timelines

Experience with government contracting, ITAR compliance, and defense industry regulations

Location Requirements

This position may be based in the vicinity of existing X-Bow offices, including:

Luling, TX

Salt Lake City, UT

Huntsville, AL

Others

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

What We Offer

Senior leadership opportunity in a cutting-edge rocket propulsion technology company

Direct impact on national defense and security initiatives

Fast-paced, innovative environment with significant growth potential

Collaborative culture with opportunity to shape organizational direction

Competitive compensation and benefits package

Opportunity to work with world-class engineering and program management teams

About Lamb Weston

You’ve probably enjoyed our fries without even knowing it! As a leading manufacturer in our industry, we inspire and bring people together with foods they love and trust. Our customer base includes international food service providers, restaurants, and households in over 100 countries around the world.

A highly innovative global corporation with a start-up mindset, we empower every individual to make a genuine difference. If you have a strong drive for results, a desire to help us bring the world together through our fries, and are ready for a fresh challenge, we want to hear from you.

The Director - Engineering Technical Support shall demonstrate skills in managing Engineering Technical SMEs (Subject Matter Experts). We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

The Developer Experience (DevX) team is a high-impact group charged with fueling the future of Crusoe’s engineering muscle. We’re responsible for critical developer tools and infrastructure that are used by all of Crusoe engineering. We focus on accelerating development while ensuring we keep a high bar for quality.

We’re looking for a Senior manager who will own multiple charter’s within DevX, in particular our AI remote agent platform, a suite of standard agents (coding, reviewing, maintenance/upgrades) running on that platform and support for our coding harnesses.

You will play a critical role in shaping our technical direction, communicating a strategic vision, and fostering a company-wide culture of engineering excellence. By partnering with stakeholders across the organization, you will define the future state of Crusoe’s evolving software development efforts and eliminate the friction that stands between an engineer and their "flow state." This is a full-time position for a visionary leader who wants to influence the long-term technical objectives of a company aligning the future of computing with the future of the climate.

What You'll Be Working On:

Engineering Acceleration: Partner with the broader organization to build paved paths that engineers love to use. Our paved paths are fast, reliable and broadly adopted across all of engineering.

Toil Elimination: Ruthlessly identify and automate away the friction and repetitive tasks that slow down the development process, keeping Crusoe engineers in a state of high productivity.
Library & Environment Creation: Develop the libraries, tools, and pre-production environments necessary for vetting service APIs and complex microservice interactions.
Ecosystem Integration: Unify internal tooling and vendor services to automate workflows, build operational efficiency, and optimize security across the development stack.
Culture of Quality: Lead efforts to establish a culture of continuous quality delivery that scales seamlessly as our engineering headcount and infrastructure grow.
System Optimization: Work diligently to build efficient systems and processes that serve as a force multiplier for the impact of every engineer around you.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

Experience: Previous experience leading multiple team charters in DevX, including managing other managers
Technical Decision-Making: Expert ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and understand how infrastructure decisions impact the daily productivity of the end-user (the developer).
Modern Tooling Proficiency: Fluent knowledge of industry-standard AI tooling, build tooling, containerization, and open-source development frameworks.
Workflow Empathy: A demonstrated passion for building empathetic developer and operator workflows that prioritize human productivity.
Cloud-Native Expertise: Professional experience managing or developing within Kubernetes clusters and a deep understanding of container orchestration.
DevOps & Reliability Background: Proven experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Release Engineering, or a similar productivity-focused discipline.
Testing Infrastructure Knowledge: Deep understanding of automated testing infrastructure and how to integrate it into a seamless CI/CD pipeline.
Language & Version Control Mastery: Expertise in modern programming languages (specifically Go) and advanced proficiency in Git-based workflows (GitLab/GitHub).
Mandatory Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related analytical field (or equivalent professional experience).

Bonus Points

Strategic Vision: Experience informing long-term company objectives through technical insight and developer-centric advocacy.
AI Platforms: Experience building AI agent platforms for engineering teams
Linux Internals: Hands-on experience with Linux image construction, package building.
